blocks.text: Iteration ka matlab hai kisi kaam ko baar baar dohrana ta ke desired result (jo nateeja chahiye us) ke qareeb pohancha ja sake. Is mein feedback ki base par tabdeeliyan aur behtari ki jati hai jab tak aakhri nateeja na mil jaye. Rozmarra zindagi mein iteration khana pakane mein nazar aati hai: aap chakh chakh kar masale aur cheezein kam zyada karte hain jab tak khana bilkul theek na ban jaye.

Misal: farz karein aap ki class school event ke liye naya logo bana rahi hai. Aap pehla design bana kar classmates ko dikhate aur un ki raye lete hain. Un ke feedback par aap design badalte hain, rang aur shaklein theek karte hain. Phir dobara feedback lete hain aur phir se tabdeeliyan karte hain. Design karna, feedback lena aur behtar karna, yeh chakkar (cycle) tab tak chalta hai jab tak aisa final logo na ban jaye jise sab pasand karein. Yahi iteration hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar dabbe ek chakkar mein: 1. Design (logo banayein ya badlein) -> 2. Share karein (classmates ko dikhayein) -> 3. Raye (feedback): rang aur shaklein kaisi? -> 4. Behtar karein (refine): tabdeeli karein -> wapas 1. Beech mein: sab ki manzoori tak dohrayein.
blocks.caption: Iteration ka chakkar: school event ke logo ki misal (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: 4-5 students ke groups banayein. Har group apni pasand ke topic par ek saada poster banaye. Pehla draft banane ke baad feedback ke liye apna poster kisi doosre group se badal lein. Un ke suggestions (mashwaron) se apna poster behtar karein, phir naya version class ke saath share karein.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity: groups poster bana kar feedback ke liye doosre group se badalte hain, behtar karte hain aur naya version share karte hain. Is mein iteration kaunsa hissa hai?
blocks.explanation: Doosre group ke feedback se poster ko badalna aur behtar version bana kar share karna; yahi baar baar behtar karne ka process iteration hai.

items: Iteration: banao, feedback lo, behtar karo, dohrao (logo ki misal).
